messages:
Sam: Heads-up — I'm planning to create the release/1.16 branch today at 18:00 UTC. Quick check: any outstanding backport requests or version-bump PRs that need to land before the cut? :hourglass_flowing_sand.

Maria: I have two v-bump PRs (docs + cli) that are approved but not merged yet. Can we merge them before cut? One is tiny, other needs a quick CI re-run.

Kevin: Re: backports — there are 3 cherry-pick asks in the backlog. Two are bugfix/critical, one is feature-ish. Proposal: critical -> cherry-pick straight into release/*, feature -> main then queue for post-cut backport. Thoughts?

Nina: Agree with Kevin. Also: please tag any PRs with label `backport/1.16` and add a short changelog line in the PR body, otherwise changelog owners will ping.

Maria: FYI the CLI bump script sometimes flips the package-lock. If you want to run locally:
```
./scripts/bump-version.sh 1.16.0
git checkout -b release/1.16
git push origin release/1.16
```
Run `npm ci` after the script to keep lockfile stable.

release-bot: 2 cherry-picks pending review: #9876 (critical), #9899 (docs). Use `/release approve <pr>` to fast-track.

Sam: OK — Maria, can you re-run CI and merge the CLI bump by 17:10 UTC? Kevin, please mark the two critical cherry-picks with `backport/1.16` and add the merge conflicts label if you expect manual fixes. I'll open the branch at 17:50 and tag owners.

Kevin: Will do. I'll also add the `changelog:bug` label to the bugfixes.

Maria: CI re-run queued, should be green in ~5m.

Nina: Quick Q — if a PR touches proto files and causes gen diffs, do we accept it in release branch or require a split PR? We had weird churn last time.

Sam: Good call. For proto/gen diffs, prefer a split PR: gen artifacts go in a separate PR with a clear commit message. If it's tiny and green, we can make an exception but flag it for follow-up.

Sam: Final ask — if you can't get approval before cutoff, open an exception ticket in #eng-releases and tag @Sam with the reason and risk assessment. I'll stay on standby from 17:30–19:30 UTC. :raised_hands:
